workspace.title: Auto refresh and notifications
workspace.description: Automatic refresh of the data on screen and desktop notifications
workspace.autoRefresh: Refresh the shown MRs, comments, and notifications every minute
workspace.autoRefreshHint: Auto refresh pauses while you type or edit, while sending, and while the app is hidden.
workspace.notifyComments: Desktop notifications for new comments on assigned and review MRs
workspace.notifyTodos: Desktop notifications for new notifications such as mentions and CI failures
workspace.notifyHint: Checks the open MR and the latest 30 comments of the 10 most recently updated assigned and review MRs. Notifications cover the 100 newest. Notifications don't include MR titles or comment text. Checks run while the app is shown and auto refresh is on.
workspace.permissionDenied: Notification permission wasn't granted. Check the Windows notification settings.
workspace.enableFailed: Couldn't turn on notifications. Check the notification settings in the desktop app.

data.description: MR data and unsent comments stored on this device
data.note: Unsent comments are managed separately from GitLab review drafts. Clearing the cache keeps unsent comments and the records used to confirm sent comments.
data.discard.title: Discard all unsent comments?
data.discard.message: All unsent comments saved on this device will be deleted. This can't be undone.
data.discard.progress: Please wait until pending saves and deletion finish.
data.discard.saveFailed: Unsent comments couldn't be saved, so your input is kept.
data.discard.failed: Couldn't discard unsent comments. Your input is kept.
